_comment: Maps each ADP payroll format to a real local fixture PDF + client config.
Copy this file to payroll_fixtures_manifest.json (gitignored) and fill in
real values — the PDF must exist at <clients_dir>/fixtures/<pdf>, and the
config must exist at <clients_dir>/<config>, both from the private
name       unique label for the test (pytest ID)
liability  optional: a second fixture PDF for workers-comp figures
format     payroll format key (matches the runner functions below)
adp_labor_distribution needs TWO entries pointing at the SAME pdf
and 'adp_labor_distribution_admin' — since it logs Agency (Div 50) and
Admin (Div 10) as two separate payroll_log.csv rows.
